reasons: The cited § 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier and operate in any field or territory, and has Vendor acknowledge no non-compete or exclusivity commitment — this meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer).

Consistent with a compliant claim, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and the paragraph is returned unchanged; the deterministic check confirming no open-ended compete restriction on Customer passed.

Declining to double-flag the § 2.2 exclusivity language (routed to the EXCLUSIVITY rule) and treating § 13.4 use restrictions and the Vendor-side § 24.2 competitor assignment limit as out of scope is correct under the playbook's no-double-flag and 'restrictions binding the Vendor are fine' guidance.
Finding is properly retained as internal evidence rather than raised as a negotiation issue; no actionable proposal is required for a compliant status.
